# Novastaq Technologies Inc - Complete Agent Guide

> Comprehensive technical and business guide for Novastaq Technologies Inc, covering software engineering capabilities, fintech & Web3 development, hardware procurement, and company information.

## Overview
Novastaq Technologies Inc is a technology company and venture studio based in Lagos, Nigeria. We engineer high-performance software, build regulated and decentralized financial infrastructure, and procure authentic tech hardware for teams and individuals.

## Services in Detail

### 1. Product Development (Web & Mobile)
- Architecture: React, TypeScript, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, Go, Python, PHP/Laravel, Postgres, Redis.
- Scope: Custom platforms, SaaS products, mobile applications, multi-tenant architectures, API design.
- Delivery: Agile sprints, automated CI/CD pipelines, production deployment, and maintenance.
- URL: https://novastaq.com/services/product-development

### 2. Fintech & Payments
- Integrations: Paystack, Monnify, Flutterwave, Nomba, Tsara, Stripe.
- Systems: Automated bank transfer verification, virtual account issuance, ledger systems, wallet balances, split payments, webhook resilience.
- Security: End-to-end encryption, fraud mitigation, tokenization, NDPR compliance.
- URL: https://novastaq.com/services/fintech

### 3. Web3 & Blockchain Infrastructure
- Protocols: EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base), Solana.
- Scope: Smart contract development (Solidity/Rust), audited tokenomics, Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization, non-custodial wallets, decentralized exchange protocols.
- Audits: Formal verification, vulnerability scanning, reentrancy prevention.
- URL: https://novastaq.com/services/web3

### 4. Product Design (UI/UX)
- Deliverables: User research, wireframes, interactive Figma prototypes, design systems, conversion optimization.
- URL: https://novastaq.com/services/design

### 5. Tech Procurement & Hardware Sourcing
- Categories:
  - Smartphones: Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel.
  - Laptops: Apple MacBook (M-series), Lenovo ThinkPad, Dell XPS/Latitude, HP Spectre/EliteBook.
  - Gadgets & Accessories: Smartwatches, wireless audio, chargers, adapters, power solutions.
  - Office & Networking: Enterprise routers, monitors, POS systems, workstation setups.
- Logistics: Insured delivery across all 36 states in Nigeria and FCT Abuja. Genuine warranty and after-sales support.
- URL: https://novastaq.com/procurement

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What does Novastaq do?
Novastaq designs, builds, and scales digital products: web and mobile apps, fintech and payment systems, and Web3 infrastructure. We also supply phones, laptops, and tech gadgets to businesses and individuals.

### How long does it take to build a product?
It depends on scope. After a short discovery call, we provide a detailed technical roadmap, milestone schedule, and fixed or milestone-based quote.

### Do you work with early-stage startups?
Yes. Our venture studio works with founders from napkin idea to launch, and continues supporting them as they scale.

### Can I buy a single device, or only in bulk?
Both. We supply individual retail buyers as well as full corporate fleet setups with bulk discounts.

### Do you deliver nationwide?
Yes. We deliver orders directly to homes or corporate offices across Nigeria.
